parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, Mara's Larch project still had BATCH-0-741 approved for batch delivery. The August 8 meeting only tested REPLAY-0-632 and did not approve any change of delivery mode.

citations.quote: 2026-08-01. Mara started project Larch. They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery.

2026-08-08. Mara reported that BATCH-0-741 lost updates during GATE-0-519 outages. The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
